options.name: config_file
options.description: Path to the kopia configuration file describing the connection. Defaults to kopia's own configuration path when unset.

options.name: password
options.description: Password securing the kopia repository. Only needed when the repository configuration does not already hold the key, and exported to the kopia CLI as E(KOPIA_PASSWORD) rather than placed on the command line.

options.name: path
options.description: Restrict the result to snapshots of this local path. All sources are listed when unset.
